title: Port Snowflake SQL to a Fabric Warehouse
objectives: Replace Snowflake-only functions with standard SQL
Rewrite QUALIFY for an engine that doesn't have it
Keep division right when the types are integers

exercises.prompt: Port the Snowflake query to SQL a Fabric Warehouse runs: for each region, the store with the highest return rate (returns / orders, 0 when orders is 0), with region, store, return_rate, discount (0 when empty) and tier ('review' at 0.1 or more, else 'ok'), in region order. Use no QUALIFY.
hints: DIV0, ZEROIFNULL and IFF are Snowflake's. NULLIF, COALESCE and CASE do the same everywhere.
COALESCE(CAST(returns AS DECIMAL(9, 4)) / NULLIF(orders, 0), 0): the CAST matters in T-SQL, where integer / integer drops the fraction.
Fabric Warehouse has no QUALIFY: number the rows with row_number() in a subquery, then WHERE n = 1 outside it.
